从房管局出来，吴姜整个人都还飘乎乎的，手里攥着购房合同、房门密码锁卡片还有一串备用钥匙。

赵经理笑着上前和吴姜握手，说道：“那吴先生，我就先回去了。您有时间了可以去房子那里看看，保洁今天已经打扫过了，家具家电都已经齐全了，您拎包就能入住。”

吴姜连声感谢，客气的说道：“谢谢赵经理了，今天麻烦您了！”

赵经理笑着摆了摆手，转身快步上了车，还特意将车窗摇下，和吴姜又客气的道别，这才开车走人。

开玩笑，这可是阮总特意打电话叫到家里吩咐的，他怎么可能不尽心尽力的。

吴姜回到家的时候，脑子里还在循环“几百万大平层”“白嫖一套房”的念头，以至于进了家门，才猛地一拍额头，懊恼地低骂了一句：“坏了！把正事给忘了！”

昨天答应了朱大庆，今天一早就联系市局刑侦队的王磊队长，告知其埋尸地点，帮朱大庆完成心愿。

答应了鬼的事情，还是要尽量满足的，吴姜叹了口气，只能明天一早再去市局了。

家里只有王雅琴在，老爹吴时安这时候应该还在古玩城，没到下班的点。

吴姜凑到厨房门口，跟老妈闲聊了两句，便转身回了自己房间。

心念一动，念念的小身影瞬间从聚灵吊坠里飘了出来，睁着亮晶晶的大眼睛，乖巧地喊了声“哥哥”。

吴姜摸了摸念念的小脑袋，随后指尖点向念念的额头，将兑换好的养魂术传给了她，轻声叮嘱：“念念，这是能让你变厉害的修炼功法，你以后可要好好修炼，这样以后就能帮助哥哥了。”

小丫头用力的点了点头：“嗯，念念以后也会很厉害的。”

吴姜笑了笑，又将小丫头收起，让她回吊坠里自个儿研究去吧。

当时王家的那个女鬼，凭着吊坠，依靠本能，都能修炼到厉鬼的阶段，想来念念通过系统的修炼，再加上他平日的供奉，以后得成就，怎么也不会比那个女鬼低的。

安顿好念念，他才拿出黄纸、朱砂和毛笔，专心练起了画符。

他发现，自己目前掌握的虽说都是些基础符箓，但只要用对地方，绝对能派上大用场，关键时刻甚至能救命。

When Wu Jiang came out of the housing management bureau, he was still in a daze, holding the house purchase contract, the door code lock card and a bunch of spare keys in his hands.

Manager Zhao smiled and stepped forward to shake hands with Wu Jiang and said: "Mr. Wu, I'll go back first. When you have time, you can go to the house and have a look. The housekeeper has cleaned it today and the furniture and appliances are complete. You can move in with just your bags."

Wu Jiang thanked him repeatedly and said politely: "Thank you, Manager Zhao. I'm sorry to trouble you today!"

Manager Zhao smiled and waved his hand, turned around and quickly got into the car. He even rolled down the window and politely said goodbye to Wu Jiang before driving away.

Just kidding, Mr. Ruan specifically called home to give instructions. How could he not do his best?

When Wu Jiang returned home, the thoughts of "a flat with several million dollars" and "a flat for free" were still circulating in his mind. As soon as he entered the house, he slapped his forehead and cursed in frustration: "That's bad! I forgot about the business!"

Yesterday, I promised Zhu Daqing, and early this morning I contacted Captain Wang Lei of the Municipal Bureau's Criminal Investigation Team to inform him of the burial location and help Zhu Daqing fulfill his wish.

Wu Jiang sighed and had to go to the city bureau early tomorrow morning.

Only Wang Yaqin is at home, and his father Wu Shi'an should still be in the antique city at this time, not getting off work yet.

Wu Jiang came to the kitchen door, chatted with his mother for a few words, then turned and went back to his room.

With a thought in his mind, Nian Nian's little figure instantly floated out of the Ling Gathering Pendant. He opened his big bright eyes and called out "brother" obediently.

Wu Jiang touched Nian Nian's little head, then pointed his fingertips to Nian Nian's forehead, and passed the redeemed soul nourishing technique to her. He whispered softly: "Nian Nian, this is a training technique that can make you powerful. You must practice it well in the future, so that you can help your brother in the future."

The little girl nodded vigorously: "Well, Nian Nian will be very powerful in the future."

Wu Jiang smiled, put the little girl away again, and let her go back to the pendant to study it by herself.

At that time, the female ghost in the Wang family could cultivate to the stage of a fierce ghost with the pendant and instinct. After thinking about it, through systematic cultivation and his daily worship, the achievements in the future would not be lower than that of the female ghost.

After settling down with Nian Nian, he took out the yellow paper, cinnabar and writing brush, and concentrated on practicing drawing talismans.

He found that although the talismans he currently had were basic, as long as they were used in the right place, they could definitely come in handy and even save lives at critical moments.
